newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Creditanstalt Q1 oper profit up 31 pct.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt Q1 oper profit up 31 pct.

text.p: Austria's Creditanstalt said on Tuesday group operating profit in the first quarter of the year rose to 2.11 billion schillings, up 31 percent from the same period of last year.

In a statement released ahead of its annual shareholders' meeting, the bank said first quarter operating earnings rose to 5.31 billion schillings from 4.58 billion a year earlier, while operating costs rose to 3.20 billion schillings from 2.97 billion in the same period of last year.
Total assets grew 7.3 percent to 737.58 billion at the end of March, it added.
Creditanstalt is controlled by market leader Bank Austria , which in January acquired the state's majority stake in the country's second largest bank. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
